newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Nomura to explore potential Bangladesh investments.
newsitem.headline: Nomura to explore potential Bangladesh investments.

text.p: Two top executives of Nomura International were due to arrive in Dhaka on Wednesday to explore investment opportunities in Bangladesh, government officials said.
They said Ilyas Khan, chief executive of Nomura's London office, and Andrew Price, the company's director in Singapore, would discusss investment prospects with ministers and officials.

"It will be an exploratory trip this time. The Nomura executives will assess opportunities here," said Rizwan Bin Faruque of the First Capital Securities, a Dhaka brokerage house which is coordinating the visit.
"But they are keen about Bangladesh," he told Reuters.
The Nomura executives are due to meet finance, commerce and telecommunication ministers, and officials of Bangladesh's Privatisation Board and Investment Board in the next few days.
Faruque said they would also meet officials of the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bangladesh's stock market watchdog, and of the Dhaka Stock Exchange.
